label: Whatever is capable of understanding and actually understands has an immanent operation
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever is able to be actually understanding (CanBe, POTENCY_3) and is actually understanding (InAct x understanding) has an immanent operation (Operates, definition 7acc985a: an operation that remains in the agent, not motion, not including being unmoved). Motivated by ST I q.18 a.3 ad 1 (understanding is an action that remains in the agent; no claim on file). A classification of understanding among immanent operations; it says nothing about life or unmovedness. The capacity condition restricts it to a being's exercise of its own capacity to understand (formal act), so a cause that contains an understander's perfection only virtually is not in its scope. Control part 3: without it, a being with the nine capable of and in act in understanding does not operate.
